name: Summer Camp with Six Bros. Baseball
operator_name: Six Bros. Sports LLC (hosted by Bellingham Youth Baseball)
description_short: A baseball skills day camp for ages 6-12 led by Six Bros. Baseball head coach Eli Sylvia and guest coaches, hosted by Bellingham Youth Baseball at Harpin St. Fields in Bellingham, MA. Two 4-day weeks (Monday to Thursday), 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM, booked by the week.

sources.note: Bellingham Youth Baseball Camps and Clinics page: 'Dates (2026): Week 1: June 29 - July 2, Week 2: July 6 - July 9'; Early Bird $215 (ends April 30), Regular $250 per week; 'Stay tuned for 2027 Registration...'
Six Bros Sports site (www.sixbrosbaseball.com, named on the camp page as where to register, redirects here): SIX BROS. SPORTS LLC, sixbrosbaseball@gmail.com, +1 774-291-1414
Bellingham, MA sits inside one ZIP code (2020 Census ZCTA relationship file, campfinder/seed/town_zips.json)

source.title: Bellingham Youth Baseball : Powered by TeamLinkt

warnings: Only the 2026 season (already over) is shown. The page says "Stay tuned for 2027 Registration...", so 2027 dates and prices are not out yet.
This page belongs to Bellingham Youth Baseball, the host league. The camp itself is run by Six Bros. Baseball, and you register on sixbrosbaseball.com, not through the league's TeamLinkt link.
Each week is 4 days (Mon-Thu). Session prices use the 2026 regular rate of $250; the early-bird rate was $215 until April 30.
The page also lists winter training clinics (Blizzard Bats Bootcamp, Knock the Rust Off). These are separate one-hour or 90-minute sessions and are not part of this listing.
